findings.body: This previously reported gap remains: seen arrays grow indefinitely, and session.end never removes their keys. Each new session also copies historical run-end IDs exposed by src/forge/board.py:289–300. Claude's [pinned store contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-code/684800b206824dfd0cc8a876e8604b20f72c3617/mods/types/claude-code.d.ts) rejects writes exceeding 4 MiB across the store. At that limit, this write fails after a successful submission, leaving the batch pending and unacknowledged so later refreshes repeatedly submit it. New-session baselines also fail. Bound retained history while preserving occurrence deduplication.
findings.title: Bound persisted seen history before Claude's store limit

findings.body: The previous routing gap remains. forge.toml:6 and .github/workflows/forge-next.yml:58 run pytest; tests/test_mod_plugin.py:45–57 only typecheck the native tests. The packaged case executes initialization and busy-reload checks, but failed-submit retries, worker/headless gating and session resets still rely on native assertions that the automated suite does not execute. SHIP owns the plugin CI job in plans/FORGE-MOD-1.md:284 and must route these tests into CI.
